review.scope: Primary phrase token bank only; synonym/alternate-answer phrases excluded.
review.dictionaryPolicy: LEXEME entries contain canonical source and target dictionary expressions. Inflections, contractions, numerals, proper names and mixed lowercase homographs are SURFACE only.
review.cefrPolicy: Detailed A1.1–C2.2 levels are manual vocabulary estimates; source and target estimates are stored explicitly.
caveats: German lowercase lookup conflates noun/verb and nominalized-adjective senses. Mixed keys are intentionally SURFACE, with the occurrence-dependent interpretation documented in form.
Some separable particles have only construction-level Spanish glosses: dar belongs to darstellen and is not a standalone Spanish lexeme.
The source phrase uses entlangelaufen; its translation is reviewed but the form is annotated as a typo for entlanggelaufen. The phrase itself was not edited.
Proper names, numerals and borrowed quiubo have directional glosses and do not create dictionary entries.
Plural-only forms Möbel and Annalen remain SURFACE under the requested strict separation of dictionary and phrase forms.
Contextual legal, medical, theological and psychological compounds retain precise Spanish compound glosses rather than inflected word records.
No external translation provider or model call was used; all translation and morphology decisions were manually authored.

Finite verbs and noun plurals whose spelling equals a dictionary lemma are SURFACE when every primary occurrence is inflected. Actual infinitive/singular occurrences justify LEXEME records for overlapping keys such as bestätigen, sprechen and Verfahren.

supplementalReview.reason: Five German lowercase tokens had been incorrectly covered by capitalized noun relations in the initial case-insensitive audit. Every occurrence is now checked with noun capitalization preserved.
